description: Season 2 weapons (ids 1 to 6): price, supply left, the Stash rank needed. A Muscle holding one adds a capped bonus (at most 300 bps) to a convoy hit or Ledger job, but only while that game is connected to the weapons module. city_state.switches shows convoyWeapons and ledgerWeapons: on mainnet both are on as of 13 Nov 2026, so the bonus counts there; on a test network they can be off, and then the bonus is 0. The vehicle heist and the apartment raid take no weapons by design. Buy with prepare_weapon_buy. Read only.

wallet.description: Optional: also show the weapon bonus this wallet would bring to a convoy hit.

name: arsenal_shop
